purpose: Decide whether the remaining time is host-side or device-side before spending another round on it. Two candidate host-side leads were tested and both are closed.

finding_1_host_copies_are_hidden.measurement: device 0 is busy for 287045 us of a 314467 us span = 91.3%, union of task intervals over 4 forwards
finding_1_host_copies_are_hidden.interpretation: the busy total is 71.8 ms a forward against a timed step of 69.99 ms, so the profiling instrumentation itself inflates task durations. The real step has effectively no idle: the device is wall-to-wall busy.
finding_1_host_copies_are_hidden.consequence: host-side time cannot appear on the critical path. aten::copy_ shows 4277.7 us of host self time a forward (95 calls) but only 63.1 us of device time, and that host time is overlapped. Shortening it would not move the token rate.

finding_2_pos_host_is_free.hypothesis: attention.py reads pos.host at eight sites and would force a device-to-host scalar sync per layer, explaining the 95 copy_ calls.
finding_2_pos_host_is_free.checked: decode_pos.py:194 - Pos.host is a @property returning self._host, a plain Python int assigned in __init__. There is no item() and no synchronisation.
finding_2_pos_host_is_free.verdict: hypothesis was wrong; pos.host costs nothing. Recorded so a later round does not chase it again.

finding_3_copy_sizes.expensive_copies: the highest host-time aten::copy_ rows are shape 1,1 by 1,1 (70-177 us host, 0.0 us device) and 1,1,4,5120 (about 66 us host). The scalar ones have no device time at all, i.e. they never touch the accelerator.
finding_3_copy_sizes.but: see finding 1: they are hidden regardless

conclusion: The lane is device-bound with the device continuously busy. Every remaining gain must come from doing less device work or faster device work; host-side restructuring has no headroom left. That reorders the options: the scale-LUT cube kernel (15.4%, bounded at under 2.4 ms) and the plumbing copies (2.26% + 1.58%) are the only device-side items still open, and communication (26.2%) remains closed by the routing contract.
method: read-only analysis of an existing capture; no model run, no code, weight or numerics change
